description: This Java class 'AuthenticationEndpoint' implements an AMQP endpoint for retrieving security tokens, handling link attachments, and managing connection states within an Eclipse Hono authentication service.

classes.name: AuthenticationEndpoint
classes.description: A class providing an AMQP endpoint for authentication token retrieval, extending AbstractAmqpEndpoint with specific link attachment and connection handling logic.

methods.name: AuthenticationEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, used for identification.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles link attachment for sender, transferring a token if QoS is AT_LEAST_ONCE.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles link attachment for receiver, delegating to superclass.

methods.name: onConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a connection is closed (no operation).

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Performs a check on message validity, currently always returns false.
